Mrs. Fisher: That flounder you caught is huge. For a second there I thought it was a halibut.
Mrs. Fisher: A flounder this big. It must be quite old. 
You: Is that bad?
Mrs. Fisher: Living at the bottom of this polluted ocean isn’t the healthiest thing a fish can do. It probably accumulated quite a lot of heavy metals.
You: Heavy metals? Should I throw it out?
Mrs. Fisher: It should be good to eat, you won’t get sick after eating one fish.
Mrs. Fisher: Something to keep in mind. Don’t eat too many of these flatheads in a short period of time, just to be sure.
You: Right.
